title: Predicated predicate
description: A predicate in the role of the second coordinate of a predication cell — the typed coordinate that indexes which fiber algebra A_p the cell's value lives in. Derives from predicate by positional role: structurally a predicated-predicate is a predicate (an object of the small predicate-category C), and the role is fixed by this schema's $id. The data shape is therefore exactly predicate's data shape, expressed as a $ref. The name is 'predicated-predicate' for symmetry with library/predicated-subject and library/predicated-object — the three together name the typed coordinates of a predication-cell at the cell-handling kernel surface.
